h:
这是一个非常简单的工作流程，可帮助您将 Ernie Image（Base 或 Turbo）GGUF 文本到图像生成数据保存到人类可读的 .txt 文件中。这将自动获取您的元数据并将其写入 .txt 文件。您将在具有工作流程的存档 (.Zip) 中找到它使用图像生成的所有保存的提示文件。此外，通过此处使用的 Image Saver Simple 节点，您可以将工作流程本身嵌入到每个保存的图像中，或者单独保存工作的图像和工作流程。

ERNIE-Image是百度开发的开源文本到图像生成模型，于2026年4月中旬正式发布。它基于紧凑的80亿参数Diffusion Transformer架构构建，旨在在消费级硬件上高效运行，同时在多语言文本渲染和复杂布局生成方面提供最先进的性能。除了标准模型之外，百度还推出了 ERNIE-Image-Turbo，这是一种使用分布匹配蒸馏和强化学习进行优化的蒸馏变体。虽然基本模型通常需要 50 个推理步骤才能达到最高质量，但 Turbo 版本只需 8 个步骤即可生成高保真图像，从而提供巨大的速度优势，同时细节损失最小。这两个模型都是在 Apache 2.0 许可证下发布的，因此对于寻求速度、 控制和精确的指令遵循。

您可以从 CivitAI 的 HuggingFace 和 LORA 下载此工作流程中使用的所有必需模型文件（详细信息如下所述）。确保您安装了足够最新的 ComfyUI，并使用 ComfyUI 管理器安装此工作流程所需的任何必要节点，并将正确的文件放置在正确的位置。另请查看我的 SD 1.5 + SDXL 1.0、Pony、WAN 2.1、WAN 2.2、MagicWAN Image v2、QWEN、HunyuanImage-2.1、HiDream、KREA、Chroma、AuraFlow、NoobAI、Illustrious、Lumina2、Z-Image Turbo、Flux.2 Klein 9B & 4B、Flux.1 Dev 和 Kandinsky Image 的其他工作流程5 Lite（T2I 和 I2I）型号。随意在您喜欢的东西上扔一些黄色的嗡嗡声。

如何使用这个 -

#1.只需首先选择您的 Ernie Image（Base 或 Turbo）GGUF 模型文件，然后

#2.设置您想要的图像尺寸开始

＃3。然后输入你想要的图片提示。

＃4。选择您想要的图像数量（更改“运行”按钮旁边的数字）

＃5。选择图像采样方法、CFG、步骤等设置

＃6。最后按运行按钮生成。就是这样..

** 此工作流程的 LORA 使用是可选的，您可以在没有任何 LORA 的情况下使用它，也可以与 1 或 2 个或任何其他数量的 LORA 一起使用，要添加新的 LORA，请按顶部的 L 按钮在新选项卡上的 LORA Manager 中找到您的 LORA，如果您想使用该 LORA，只需单击向上的 Kite 按钮。

所需文件

===============

### Ernie 图像 GGUF 模型的下载链接 -

++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++

https://huggingface.co/unsloth/ERNIE-Image-GGUF/resolve/main/ernie-image-Q4_K_M.gguf

https://huggingface.co/unsloth/ERNIE-Image-Turbo-GGUF/resolve/main/ernie-image-turbo-Q4_K_M.gguf

### Ernie Image FP8 型号的下载链接（可选）-

++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++

https://huggingface.co/Bedovyy/ERNIE-Image-Quantized/resolve/main/ernie-image-fp8.safetensors

https://huggingface.co/Bedovyy/ERNIE-Image-Quantized/resolve/main/ernie-image-turbo-fp8.safetensors

如果您在运行完整的常规模型和 GGUF 模型时遇到问题，但您的硬件可以处理这些 FP8 模型（12GB 或更高的 VRAM），您可以使用这些模型

### Ernie 图像文本编码器的下载链接 -

+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++

https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/ERNIE-Image/resolve/main/text_encoders/ministral-3-3b.safetensors

### Ernie Image VAE 下载链接 -

++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++

https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/flux2-dev/resolve/main/split_files/vae/flux2-vae.safetensors

是的！正如您所看到的，这只是您的 Flux.2 VAE，如果您已经为 Flux.2 Klein（4B 或 9B）下载了它，您可以跳过再次下载，而只使用您已经使用过的版本。

### Ernie 图像提示增强器的下载链接（可选）-

+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++

https://huggingface.co/Bedovyy/ERNIE-Image-Quantized/resolve/main/text_encoders/ernie-image-prompt-enhancer-fp8.safetensors

我在此工作流程中跳过了使用提示增强器，以便更简单、更快地生成，但如果您像我一样喜欢尝试现有工作流程，并且拥有更好的硬件可以处理 FP8 模型（12GB 或更高 VRAM），您可以调整并将其与 Ernie Image（基本或 Turbo）FP8 模型合并

洛拉使用 -

++++++++++++

ERNIE-图像涡轮洛拉 -

https://civitai.red/models/2551180/ernie-image-turbo-lora?modelVersionId=2867032

当与 Ernie Image Base 模型一起使用时，从 Ernie Image Turbo 中提取的 Lora 可以将步骤数减少到 12，以便在基本（8GB 或 12GB VRAM）GPU 上更快地生成。生成的图像有时会产生轻微降级的输出。如果您使用 Ernie Image Turbo 模型，或者想要使用标准的 30 到 50 个步骤、CFG 5 到 7.5 以及 Ernie Image Base 模型来获得所需的输出，则可以跳过此步骤。

o.en:
This is a very simple workflow that helps you to save your Ernie Image (Base or Turbo) GGUF Text to Image Generation Data into a human readable .txt file. This will automatically get and write your metadata to the .txt file. You will find all the saved prompt files that it generated with the images inside the Archive (.Zip) that has the workflow. Also with the Image Saver Simple node used here you may embed the workflow itself with each saved image or save the image and workflow for your work separately.

ERNIE-Image is an open-source text-to-image generation model developed by Baidu and officially released in mid-April 2026. Built on a compact 8-billion parameter Diffusion Transformer architecture, it is designed to run efficiently on consumer-grade hardware while delivering state-of-the-art performance in multilingual text rendering and complex layout generation. Alongside the standard model, Baidu introduced ERNIE-Image-Turbo, a distilled variant optimized using Distribution Matching Distillation and reinforcement learning. While the base model typically requires 50 inference steps to reach peak quality, the Turbo version can generate high-fidelity images in just 8 steps, providing a massive speed advantage with minimal loss in detail. Both models are released under the Apache 2.0 license, making them highly accessible for developers and creators looking for a balance between speed, control, and precise instruction following.

You can download all of your necessary model files used in this workflow from HuggingFace and LORA from CivitAI (Details are mentioned below). Make sure you have latest enough ComfyUI installation and install any necessary nodes for for this workflow using ComfyUI manager and place the correct files in correct places. Also check out my other workflows for SD 1.5 + SDXL 1.0, Pony, WAN 2.1, WAN 2.2, MagicWAN Image v2, QWEN, HunyuanImage-2.1, HiDream, KREA, Chroma, AuraFlow, NoobAI, Illustrious, Lumina2, Z-Image Turbo, Flux.2 Klein 9B & 4B, Flux.1 Dev and Kandinsky Image 5 Lite (T2I & I2I) models. Feel free to toss some yellow Buzz on stuffs you like.

How to use this -

#1. Just select your Ernie Image (Base or Turbo) GGUF model files first and

#2. set your desired image dimensions to start

#3. then input your desired image prompt.

#4. select how many images you want (Change the number besides the "Run" button)

#5. select image sampling methods, CFG, steps etc. settings

#6. finally press the run button to generate. That's it..

** LORA usage for this workflow is optional you can use it without any LORAs, use with 1 or 2 or any other number of LORAs, to add new LORAs press the L button on top to lunch LORA Manager on a new tab find your LORA and if you want to use that LORA just click the upward Kite button.

Required Files

===============

### Download Link for Ernie Image GGUF Models -

++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++

https://huggingface.co/unsloth/ERNIE-Image-GGUF/resolve/main/ernie-image-Q4_K_M.gguf

https://huggingface.co/unsloth/ERNIE-Image-Turbo-GGUF/resolve/main/ernie-image-turbo-Q4_K_M.gguf

### Download Link for Ernie Image FP8 Models (Optional) -

++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++

https://huggingface.co/Bedovyy/ERNIE-Image-Quantized/resolve/main/ernie-image-fp8.safetensors

https://huggingface.co/Bedovyy/ERNIE-Image-Quantized/resolve/main/ernie-image-turbo-fp8.safetensors

You can use these if you have trouble running both the full regular models & GGUF models but your hardware can handle these FP8 models (12GB or higher VRAM)

### Download Link for Ernie Image Text Encoder -

+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++

https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/ERNIE-Image/resolve/main/text_encoders/ministral-3-3b.safetensors

### Download Link for Ernie Image VAE -

++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++

https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/flux2-dev/resolve/main/split_files/vae/flux2-vae.safetensors

Yes! as you can see it is just your Flux.2 VAE, if you have already downloded this for Flux.2 Klein (4B or 9B) you can skip downloading it again and just use the one you already used.

### Download Link for Ernie Image Prompt Enhancer (Optional) -

+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++

https://huggingface.co/Bedovyy/ERNIE-Image-Quantized/resolve/main/text_encoders/ernie-image-prompt-enhancer-fp8.safetensors

I have skipped using the Prompt Enhancer in this workflow for simpler and faster generation but if you are someone who likes to experiment with existing workflows like me and have better hardware that can handle FP8 models (12GB or higher VRAM) you can tweak and incorporate this with Ernie Image (Base or Turbo) FP8 model

LORA used -

++++++++++++

ERNIE-Image Turbo Lora -

https://civitai.red/models/2551180/ernie-image-turbo-lora?modelVersionId=2867032

This Lora extracted from Ernie Image Turbo can reduce the number of steps to 12 for faster generation on basic (8GB or 12GB VRAM) GPUs when used with Ernie Image Base model.. the resulting image sometimes can produce slighlty degraded outputs. You can skip this if you are using the Ernie Image Turbo model or if you want to use the standard 30 to 50 steps, CFG 5 to 7.5 with Ernie Image Base model for your desired output.
